title: Kurban anu Ngarobah Takdir
intro: Dina mangsa mimiti kahirupan manusa, aya hiji jiwa anu masihan hiji kado kalawan niat anu murni. Tapi, rasa sirik nyumput dina kalangkang katampi. Panggihan carita tokoh ieu anu kasolehan sareng tungtungna tragisna diabadikeun dina wahyu ilahi.
clues: Abdi kalebet generasi umat manusa anu mimiti pisan.
Abdi parantos masrahkeun kurban ka Gusti, sareng éta ditampi kalayan nikmat.
Kurban lanceuk kuring ditolak, jeung sirik ngagelapkeun haténa.

Kuring nyarita ka anjeunna, 'Lamun anjeun ngulurkeun leungeun anjeun ka kuring rék maehan kuring, kuring moal ngulurkeun leungeun kuring rék maehan anjeun; saenyana kuring sieun ka Allah, Pangéran sakumna alam.'
Kuring jadi korban tina tindakan rajapati anu munggaran di bumi.
Getih kuring ngajerit, jeung kuring jadi martir polos nu munggaran.

trial.answer: Kurbanna ditarima, ngabalukarkeun lanceukna sirik sareng anjeunna dibunuh.

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
